summary: Merge-back mechanics done. lib/git.js: added currentBranch(ws) (rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) + mergeBranch(ws,taskKey,opts) — resolves orch/attempt/<slug>, git merge --no-ff into base; success {merged:true,head,branch}; conflict -> collects --diff-filter=U files, git merge --abort, returns {merged:false,conflict:true,files,branch}; best-effort {merged:false,reason} on not-a-repo/missing-branch; both exported. daemon.js: POST /git/merge {key,message?} (409 if not a repo, 400 if no key, returns mergeBranch result, notifyChange). lib/mcp-core.js: added merge_attempt tool {task_key}->POST /git/merge, inserted after git_status before show_dashboard (now 23 tools). test/git-merge.test.js (framework-less, git.test.js style): 15/15 PASS — clean merge of two different-file attempts, conflicting same-file pair aborts to baseline-clean tree, missing-branch/not-a-repo no-throw. VERIFY on throwaway daemon (ORCH_PORT=8799, isolated CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA, temp repo, killed by PID; live :8787 untouched): POST /git/merge clean -> {merged:true,head,branch} & file on base; missing key -> 400; never-branched -> {merged:false,reason}; /mcp tools/list shows merge_attempt (23 total); tools/call merge_attempt isError:false. CAVEAT: user MUST restart live :8787 daemon AND reload the orchestrator-graph MCP server before /git/merge endpoint + merge_attempt tool appear in-session.
